Start with search: `query` is the question (sk/en); `place`, `domain`, `theme`, `type` narrow it; hits name Endpoint, nextQuery. Or query `endpoint` catalog (DCAT-AP): `q` on searchText (`searchText~="bystrica"`), `georel` near. Both hold only what you may read. search_documents: by `publisher`, `translations`, `pathPrefix`; read_knowledge_context: around `chunkId`. list_endpoints: by `space`, `access`, `attribute`; get_endpoint: card, links, `detail`. render_chart: PNG of one `data` {tool, arguments} read, `spec` Vega-Lite subset. Each tool takes `endpoint`. `jc:source`: federated sources.
